title: sivastotravali — s15-v19
question: The world-road is long; limbs burnt by harsh diseases; pleasures unenjoyed; happiness never long — thus I have become useless, moon-crest-foot-pressed, wholly Yours — so make me, quickly, long-and-rich in great fortune, as Your devotee.
